title: Cleaning Checklist Status Mix
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cleaning:checklist
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(checklist_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the cleaning checklist feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `checklist_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges the overall mood of your cleaning checklist feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
